citation: Kenoyer, Jonathan Mark. 1991. “The Indus Valley Tradition of Pakistan and Western India.” Journal of World Prehistory 5 (4): 331–385. DOI 10.1007/BF00978474 (Springer/Plenum).
notes: Peer-reviewed synthesis. Table I (p. 333 of the journal PDF) lists Indus Tradition eras: Regionalization Era ca. 5000–2600 BCE; Integration Era 2600–1900 BCE; Localization Era 1900–1300 BCE. Discusses settlement hierarchy, crafts, trade, undeciphered script (no bilingual texts), and debates on state-level organization. Author PDF hosted on harappa.com (accessed 2026-10-11).
